d:
Presenting the Kannada travel song "Prakruti - Nature" by Anup in collaboration with Travel Karnataka.
The song is a journey of a person who finds true meaning of life through music and nature. The entire video describes the beauty of Karnataka and the value of protecting nature.
Song Writing / Singing / Lyrics / Music Production / Video Editing - ANUP K R
Cinematography - NIKHIL VIRDI
Video Color Grading - Argenil Productions (ANIL PRASAD)
Audio Mix/Mastering - Argenil Productions (ROHIT GANDHI)
Location Managers - GAGAN PRAKASH & ROHIT GOWDA
Additional Kodagu Drone Footage - VINAYAK TSALLA
